                              ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICA GO:


SECTION I . Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

be amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No.l 1 -M in the area bounded by

       a line 201 feet north of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; a Public
       Alley 125.21 feet east of and parallel to North Marmora Avenue; a line
       171 feet north of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; and North
       Marmora Avenue;

to those of an RT4 Residential Two-Flat Townhouse and Multi-Unit District is

hereby established in the area above described.


SECTION2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.
